name: hisense-huangshan
description: 2023 Hisense Android TV: Android 10, MediaTek MT5895, 2 GB RAM, stock Android TV launcher. The reference device kyoto was built on.
notes: Keep/disable decisions for streaming apps reflect one household. Review every 'optional' entry against the apps you actually watch.
USB debugging also exposes adb over Wi-Fi on port 5555, and it survives reboots.
The stock launcher (com.google.android.tvlauncher) is a priority-2 system HOME; `kyoto home set` disables it reversibly.
Picture settings changed by hand are recorded in docs/case-study/hisense-huangshan/picture-settings.md.
